kind.question: Question
q.title: To close
q.sub: Agent answers and change proposals to decide, and applied edits to confirm. Keys: A accept/keep · R reopen/reject · W won't do · J/K next/previous.

q.reopen_prompt: What is still missing? (sent back to the agent)
q.counts: {o} open comments · {a} approved, waiting for the implementer
dec.title: Decisions & dialogue
dec.sub: Agents propose states; only your sealed decision approves.
dec.pick: Click a question to see only its discussion.
ql.title: Quality
ql.sub: Read-only checks from the enabled plugins — no global score; each one names its rule.
lit.title: Literature & citations
lit.filter: Filter by key, author, title, year…
ag.title: Agents
ag.sub: Roles are templates any agent can run as a sub-agent. Tasks are the work packets; reviews are their validated outputs.
ag.export: Export roles to your tools: python3 -m atw roles export --to claude | skills | markdown
cfg.title: Configuration
ov.to_close_h: {c} changes to decide · {r} in the text without your approval
pg.explain: The limit is pages without citations or references. Words only translate it, with each chapter's own words per page from its last PDF.
ms.no_changes: No changes proposed for this chapter.
ms.pdf_comments_hint: Comments and changes are made on the text, not on the PDF. Switch to Text to comment.
pdf.from_tex: from the hand-written .tex — may not reflect the Markdown
pdf.tex_out_of_sync: The .tex in the LaTeX folder is older than the Markdown (the PDF here uses the Markdown).
pdf.none_hint: Compile to see how the chapter looks in LaTeX.
q.change_review: Already in the text without your approval — keep it?
q.register_sub: A sealed moderator block will be appended to each thread:
check.changes_review: Changes in the text without your approval
check.changes_lost: Pending changes whose text is gone
lit.seal_h: files unchanged since sealing · {c} changed · {n} not sealed
lit.match_h: title found in the source · {d} doubtful · {m} mismatch · {x} without text · {s} without source
lit.passages_h: works with at least one sentence checked against its passage (citation ledger)
ms.narrative: What this chapter must argue (your plan)
ms.narrative_src: From {f} — your plan, not a workbench rule.
ms.counts: {c} open comments · {x} open changes (of {tc} and {tx}, closed ones shown faded)
ms.orphans: Lost their place in the text
cfg.plan_h: Chapters, pages, words, sections, narrative and writing rules come from {f}. The workbench has no limits of its own.
cfg.no_plan: No plan file: add [project] plan = ".thesis/plan.toml" to set your own targets.
sign.missing: Approvals are off: no signing key.
sign.missing_h: The workbench never creates a second key, so every tool verifies the same seals. Set [agents] key_path in thesis.toml to the key you already use (expected at {p}), or create one with python3 -m atw key init.
ctx.none: No context files configured ([context] in thesis.toml).
ql.thesis_h: The whole thesis: structure against your plan, page balance, links and terms across chapters, overall verification and the narrative across chapters.
ql.section_h: Each problem from the chapter checks, placed in the section where it occurs. Click a section for the details.
check.term_variants: Same term written differently across chapters
work.no_summary: No summary file (00_*.md) in the work's folder.
work.no_text: No full_text.md in the work's folder.
work.no_pdf: No PDF in the work's folder.
sign.missing_toast: Not approved: the workbench has no signing key yet. Add key_path under [agents] in thesis.toml, pointing to the key your other tools already use; then approve again.
lib.title: Reference manager: {s}
lib.none: Bibliography from a file. To use Zotero or Mendeley, set [citations] provider = "zotero" or "mendeley" in thesis.toml.
out.title: Output: base and template
out.sub: The thesis document is built on a template, in LaTeX or Word. Applying copies the template once; later runs only refresh its generated parts.
out.hint: Choose the base with [output] base = "latex" | "word" and the template with [output] template in thesis.toml; fields (school, programme, supervisors) go in [template].
